== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster expressly names the opponent and a starship in the weapon-targeting restriction. Both retain the Pilot 3 bonus and the Jabba battle penalties. The printed scope can be compared without assuming a particular legal friendly-weapon case.
